verdict: Spend is running; zero leads recorded — conversion tracking is being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $634.24 was spent on Google Ads and 133 clicks reached your site, yet zero leads were recorded across all channels. Conversion tracking is not capturing those clicks correctly, and the paid landing pages are being confirmed as live and functional this week — both are the direct cause of the zero-lead figure. Google Business Profile showed genuine organic interest with 49 actions and 48 direction requests this period, confirming that local intent exists; the paid funnel simply has no working capture path right now. An end-to-end test of the full system is underway to close this gap. Once tracking is verified, lead volume should begin reflecting the click traffic already coming in.
